From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Role matrix and interviewer playbook — alignment request

Jonas —

Thanks for sending this over. Quick pass below (I also left comments in the drive doc):

Top 3 non-negotiable Senior signals (my vote):
- Reproducible debugging of performance regressions (e.g., isolating KV cache vs kernel issues)
- Clear trade-off reasoning for latency vs cost (can propose quantization/ batching choices)
- System-level ownership on rollout/rollback strategies (incidents, fallback models)

Interview focus split (my recommendation):
- Round 1 (45m): System troubleshooting + incident postmortem (scored 40% on ownership, 60% on approach)
- Round 2 (60m): Model-serving architecture (KV cache, batching, quantization)
- Round 3 (45m): Behavioral/depth interview (ship/lead stories)

Playbook edits: add a short rubric appendix with explicit pass thresholds (e.g., 3/5 avg across technical rounds and no \"red\" for ownership). Also call out acceptable compensating signals (open-source contributions / production GPU ops).

CC'ing Marissa for intake preferences and scheduling windows.

Cheers,
Lauren

- Example of an incident where KV cache invalidation led to SLA impact and how they diagnosed it.
- A concrete design trade-off: given 100 GPU hours budget, how would they prioritize model compilation, caching, and quantization?

Panel assignments (proposed):
- Systems debugging: Marissa Cole (lead) — 9/3 09:30 PT
- Model-serving architecture: Jonas Weber (lead) — 9/3 11:00 PT
- Behavioral/ownership: Lauren Bishop (lead) — 9/3 14:00 PT
